figures.caption: Figure 1: v2 learning curve (1000 steps). Left/blue: logged training reward (mean), rising 0.22 → ≈0.43 then plateauing. Right/red: held-out pass@1 on the 68 competition problems per checkpoint — base 5.9% (4/68), rising to an 8.8% (6/68) plateau over steps 250–750, with a mild regression to 7.4% (5/68) at step 1000. Differences within the plateau correspond to ±1 problem out of 68 (within sampling noise); the robust signal is base → RLVR (4 → 5–6/68).
